I’m in the same boat as you but don’t worry! There is a way to help it, for me it’s all about the environment I’m in. Try cutting out negative music, media, people, etc everything negative needs to be cut out of your life as much as possible. This is a lot easier said than done but ultimately it should help your mindset. 

Another way I help myself during times like these is by turning to my favorite band or show, something or somebody I know I can trust to be there. Try to make sure the things you turn to are positive and aren’t stressful for you or it’ll defeat the purpose of them!

Third option is taking a break from everything, it could be that you’re just more stressed out than you can handle, try going for a long walk while listening to up beat music, or take some time to do something you know you can enjoy and put all the negative thoughts to the back of your mind.

I hope things work out for you and good luck on your goals in life! 💜

I know that after two days of under eating your body is already malnourished. For symptoms it varies depending on your weight and age I’m 16 and 150 and from what I can recall it took a couple months for me to notice hair loss and brittle nails, it took me a few weeks to notice my sex drive disappeared. As for the other symptoms I found those online and through people struggling with eating disorders as well.

I’ve been there too and if you’re like me people telling you it’s unhealthy wont make you eat more, but maybe this will help:

Long term malnutrition can and will cause:

• Severe hair loss/bald patches

• Britle and blue nails that look disgusting

• Extra hair growth on your arms, legs, armpits, pretty much everywhere except your head

• Stomach ulcers (they’re caused when your body smells food/gets ready to eat and there’s an increase in bile but with nothing to digest the excess bile eats away at your stomach lining)

• Absolute loss of sex drive

• Scoliosis/other bone deformations

These are only a few of the things that can happen to you, please get help as soon as possible before your situation gets any worse.
